footer: You're receiving this email because of your Tripinly account. It was sent automatically; replies aren't read.

data_export_ready.subject: Your Tripinly data is ready
data_export_ready.heading: Your data export is ready
data_export_ready.body: You asked for a copy of your Tripinly data. You can download it with the button below. The link works for 7 days.
data_export_ready.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email, and consider signing out of Tripinly on your other devices.

account_deletion_confirmed.subject: Your Tripinly account has been deleted
account_deletion_confirmed.heading: Your account has been deleted
account_deletion_confirmed.body: As you asked, your Tripinly account and the data connected to it have been deleted. We won't email you again.
